questions.question: What is the main purpose of Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
options: To make machines think and perform tasks that normally require human intelligence

questions.question: Which of the following is the BEST example of AI?
options: A fan rotating at one speed
A voice assistant answering your questions

questions.question: Which activity below most likely uses Artificial Intelligence?
options: A smartphone unlocking using face recognition

questions.question: How is AI different from a normal computer program?
options: AI can learn from data and improve its decisions

questions.question: Which of these is an everyday application of AI?
A navigation app suggests the fastest route because it can:
options: Learn from traffic data and make decisions

questions.question: Which statement about humans and AI is TRUE?
options: AI has real emotions like humans
Humans can think creatively and understand feelings better than AI
AI is always smarter than every human

questions.question: A smart speaker answers your questions after listening to your voice. Which AI ability is mainly being used first?
Which device is LEAST likely to use AI?
Why do companies use AI in shopping websites?
options: To recommend products customers may like

questions.question: Which example shows AI learning from experience?
options: A recommendation app suggesting better movies after learning what you watch
A door opening with a key
A book staying on a shelf

questions.question: A robot vacuum changes its path after detecting furniture. This shows AI can:
options: Observe its surroundings and make decisions

questions.question: Which task is usually easier for humans than AI?
options: Understanding emotions in a friend's face

questions.question: Which pair correctly matches an AI application with its task?
If an AI assistant suggests songs based on your previous listening habits, it is mainly using:
Which statement BEST explains why AI is becoming common in daily life?
options: It can help people perform many tasks faster and smarter
It removes the need for electricity

questions.question: A language translation app converts English into Hindi instantly. This is an example of AI because it:
Which situation requires AI instead of a simple fixed program?
options: Recognizing different animals in thousands of photos

questions.question: Why is AI not exactly the same as human intelligence?
options: AI learns from data but does not naturally think, feel, or understand like humans

questions.question: Which of the following BEST describes Artificial Intelligence?
options: Machines using data to recognize patterns, learn, and make intelligent decisions
Machines that only follow one fixed instruction forever
Computers that work only without humans
